capabilities: Open diagrams in a popup with ctrl+click or an open button
Zoom and drag diagrams with mouse, touch gestures, or UI buttons
Configure custom popup targets such as images by CSS class name
Set image max height and open button position in settings
extras: Installation is currently described only through the BRAT beta-plugin installer; the README says other install methods are yet to be added.
problem: Obsidian renders diagrams inline at a fixed size, making large diagrams hard to read or inspect closely.

relations.evidence: You could get it from the BRAT plugin which you could download from the comunity plugins

summary: Diagram viewer that opens Mermaid, PlantUML and Graphviz diagrams in a draggable, zoomable popup window.
